title: A1MorphChapter/v2 (agent answer)
description: A scene module for one chapter of a continuous diagram, and what it asks the line to fetch or draw first: real maps (OpenStreetMap) and 示意 pictures (text-free generated art). Rules: work/recipe-board-v1/prompts/morph.md. Checked by chapter.mjs before it is accepted.

motionImplementation.description: For motionRules contracts, one implementation index per shotId: exact uncommented excerpts of current code. Scoped beats also compare their bound reference at start/change/end; the existing blind review judges the actual poses. Legacy answers may use null.

sourceTaskInputHash.description: Copy input.sourceTaskInputHash from the current task; answers for a different task version are rejected.

patches.description: revision rounds: exact edits to previousAnswer.code (find must occur once); code is then left empty

file.description: Existing project-relative art file to reuse instead of generating again.

glyphs.description: a word's outlines from a house font, for letters built in 3D (kit.blockType): data[key]; [] when none

face.description: a house font family: House Sumikaku, House Kaiso, House Kikai, House Kokka, House Soukou, House Kinkaku

bakes.description: Offline Blender requests; null preserves previous requests on a patch, [] clears them. Legacy answers may omit this field. rigid → A1RigidBakeRequest/v1 JSON text, consumed by kit.engine.baked.rigid(data[key]); camera → A1CameraRequest/v1 JSON text (OptFlowCam long take with an S-curve stop), consumed by kit.engine.baked.camera(data[key]). A requested bake must be read by the module (bakeUseErrors).

pages.description: pages drawn by the card line's modules and shown in the chapter as moving pictures (images[key], images[key].frame(s)): a captured article with its sentences marked (module article), real prices (market), a chat, a quote; spec is the module's spec as JSON text, checked and rendered by the card renderer (modules.mjs renderModule) with its checks

subjects.description: Whole-object descriptions for automatic subjects the library does not have (kit.engine.subject '<id>' outside h100/hdd/drill, when engine/subjects/auto/<id>.json is absent): id + what the whole object is, in English, no text or logos. The line writes tasks/subject-<id>.task.json (parts plan, prompts/subject.md) and builds the parts by multi-view image-to-3D; until the plan is answered the chapter waits and does not render. null/[] = the chapter needs no automatic subject.
